verdict.rationale: Deel's own individuals page promises a "dedicated case manager and attorneys," and its immigration page says "in-house experts file forms." That shows some attorney involvement and in-house filing. However, the pages never say the filers are licensed attorneys, never name any lawyer, and never describe an attorney-of-record model. Missing for 10: named or licensed immigration attorneys on Deel's pages, an explicit attorney-of-record or attorney-prepared-and-filed petition model, and independent corroboration of attorney supervision.

support.subject: As a founder, my petition is prepared and filed by licensed immigration attorneys — named lawyers or a stated attorney-of-record model on the provider's own pages, not an unsupervised form service

citations.quote: Dedicated case manager and attorneys (responses within 24 hours)
Our in-house experts file forms, organize your consulate appointments, and provide specific preparation for your visa interview.
